company.name: Shipper
company.shortDescription: Shipper is a logistics platform that helps freight forwarders deliver goods easily.
company.description: Shipper is a digital logistics platform that helps freight forwarders to deliver goods easily. It works with online or corporate vendors to pick up items to be shipped using selected logistics services. It cooperates with online sellers or companies to pick up goods to be sent using selected logistics services. Its platform offers package pick-up service and fulfillment centers, help logistics providers manage shipments, predicts shipping routes, consolidate packages headed in the same direction, and also provides a multi-carrier API that enables sellers to manage orders, print shipping labels, and get tracking information from multiple providers on their phones.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $43,749,882, or 33.17% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,095,476 to $499,676,279, a 161.42x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 58 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
